marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 30 knots diminishing to west 20 late this
afternoon and to light late this evening. Wind increasing to southeast 20
Saturday morning. Scattered flurries. Temperatures near minus 1. <br/>

this evening.<br/>
